posts.message_html:
Hello DeepakRaj02,

Welcome to Lenovo Community

I understand that your Lenovo Yoga Pro 9 16IAH10's (83L0) screen auto dims, blacks out and brightens, as well as having Netflix freezing issue with error code : D7353 - 5101.
When did the issue started? Any computer changes?
Please try the following:
-remove all external peripherals
-reload the BIOS default settings, be sure to save
-install all applicable updates from the support site, restart once done
-proceed with the screen flickering troubleshooting steps
Test, observe and update us how it goes.

Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo
